svg.title: Inspect a paused Cline request in VS Code with automatic actions off
svg.desc: 1: Plan is selected; switch to Act only after reviewing the plan. 2: Auto-approve is None; inspect the pending command and its scope. 3: Check the model/provider selector against the course CPD setup.
